priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Cast Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if Flame Shock is not ticking on the target.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Ascendance, Doom Winds, or while Surging Totem is active.
Cast Sundering if Whirling Earth is active or if you have the Surging Elements or Feral Spirit talents.
Cast Lava Lash if Whirling Fire or Hot Hand is active.
Cast Primordial Storm if you have 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks, or if the buff is expiring soon and you have at least 5 stacks.
Cast Ascendance when ready to spend Maelstrom Weapon on a Thorim's Invocation-empowered Lightning Bolt.
Cast Stormstrike and Crash Lightning during Doom Winds or Ascendance windows to trigger Thorim's Invocation.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Crash Lightning if the Crash Lightning buff is not active.
Cast Lava Lash and Stormstrike as fillers when no higher-priority abilities are available.
Cast Lightning Bolt if you have 5 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks and no other priority actions.
